profile.name: SCPI通用仪器软件接口
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验中以统一方式连接和访问支持 SCPI 命令的仪器。它提供端口、资源标识和连接参数管理，以及通用的写入、读取、查询、复位和初始化操作，适合用于构建各类仪器的上层控制流程。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for uniformly connecting to and accessing instruments that support SCPI commands in laboratory workflows. It manages ports, resource identifiers, and connection parameters, and provides generic write, read, query, reset, and initialization operations for higher-level instrument control.
